verdict.rationale: Crossplane is installed into your own Kubernetes cluster with the documented Helm chart, including `helm install` commands, feature flags, dry-run inspection and pre-release channels. Its source is public on GitHub. Community users confirm running it on their own clusters, such as a Rancher cluster. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the open-source license, and a bootstrap path for the underlying Kubernetes cluster (a community commenter notes you must set up k8s yourself).
